resources.string: A tiny pet that walks onto your screen when you doomscroll.
Mochi walks over Instagram when you scroll for too long or too late.
See Mochi walk across your screen right now.
Let Mochi see when Instagram is open
Mochi needs Android’s “Usage access” to know when Instagram is on screen and for how long. That’s all it looks at, and it never leaves your phone.
Let Mochi walk over other apps
“Display over other apps” lets Mochi stroll across your screen on top of Instagram. Mochi can’t see or touch anything you do underneath.
While Mochi is keeping watch, Android shows a small notification. Allow it so you can always tell Mochi is on duty.
How long you can scroll without a break before Mochi steps in.
From this time until your wake time, Mochi nudges you to sleep whenever Instagram is open.
How long Mochi waits before visiting again.
After Mochi\'s five visits, Instagram is locked until you answer a few of Mochi\'s questions.
Only in debug builds. Shortcuts for trying Mochi quickly; the cooldown is set to 1 minute.
A quiet notification that shows while Mochi is keeping an eye on your scrolling.
Mochi is keeping an eye out 👀

Digital wellbeing: while the user has switched on Floating Mochi, the service periodically checks on-device usage statistics to see whether a watched social app has been open for a long time or late at night, then shows a short break reminder. No data leaves the device.
Mochi, a mint-green blob with swirly dizzy eyes
Mochi, a sleepy mint-green blob with closed eyes
